Nora (People Ops): Heads-up — new hire in BR started 2026-12-28 and we discovered the system both prorated accrual and also applied year-end encashment rules. Their PTO got partially encashed and also prorated down. Can payroll review? @payroll
Jin (Payroll): Thanks Nora. Can you paste the employee id and the exact dates? Encashment runs on the 31st cutoff, so hire_date might've triggered both proration and encashment.
Camila (Hiring): cid:50987, start_date: 2026-12-28, FTE: 0.8. Manager told them to treat 12/29 as onboarding day (no PTO). They were never expected to have encashed hours.
Marco (Manager): Confirmed I asked for onboarding coverage; did not authorize encashment. We expected proration only.
Nora (People Ops): Export from HRIS (sanitized):
- cid:50987 start_date=2026-12-28, accrual_prorated=true, encashment_applied=4h on 2026-12-31, PTO_balance_post=0h
Jin (Payroll): Yep, looks like the year-end encashment job didn't exclude hires within last 5 days. We have rule PAY_ENCASH_002: exclude hires <7 days, but recent calendar change to Brazil locale mapping broke the exclusion.
Jin (Payroll): We can reverse the encash and restore prorated balance if manager approves. Need attestation per audit. Command I'll run once approved:
```bash
payroll_tools/reverse_encash --cid 50987 --journal "AJ-ENC-2026-112" --note "encashment_exclusion_failure"
```
HRIS Bot: created ticket HRIS-2026-778 for locale mapping change
Camila (Hiring): I approve reversal and request payroll to restore prorated accrual for 0.8 FTE.
Marco (Manager): I approve — please restore the expected balance and attach approval.
Jin (Payroll): Running reversal now. ETA next payroll run; journal AJ-ENC-2026-112 created. Also added detection PAY_ENC_009 to flag hires within 7 days who were encashed.
Jin (Payroll): Reversal queued, balances updated in HRIS. No retro tax impact expected; logging audit note.
Nora (People Ops): I'll update the onboarding checklist to flag hires during year-end blackout and add a step to confirm encashment exclusion. Also will publish a short FAQ for managers.
Marco (Manager): Thanks — confirmed the new hire sees corrected balance in portal.
Nora (People Ops): Closing thread and filing incident HR-2026-501 for follow-up. If anyone spots similar behavior in other locales, ping me directly.
